_README: ⛔ GAP-8 — the scan floors. Each entry is the non-blank line count the gate READ after stripping. A gate reading less than its floor has gone blind and reds; see scripts/lib/scanFloor.ts. ⚠ WHY A 5% MARGIN AND NOT THE EXACT MEASUREMENT: these counts are 1k–70k lines and move with every ordinary commit, so an exact floor would red permanently and train people to raise the number without reading it — the failure web-e2e.yml's header records killing the previous lane. The margin still catches the failure being guarded: total blinding drops the count to ~0, and losing a root or an extension drops it by far more than 5%. ⛔ The floor is DOWNWARD-ONLY: lowering it needs a stated reason, exactly like HOSTILE_FLOOR.

rounding.why: S1.12.5.6 [pass-5 A5-4]. Wired because lint:scan-floors REFUSED this gate on its first run - it strips its input and had no floor, which is GAP-8: a gate that strips can report a pass while reading nothing. Its own downward-only cap does not protect it, and in fact inverts: a scan that suddenly reads zero files reports FEWER copies, and the gate would then ask someone to lower the cap to match. 5% margin per the _README.
